speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome. I see you are a newborn with increasing yellowing of the skin and eyes; have you noticed this jaundice appearing within the first 24 hours of life?

speaker: Patient
text: 2-week-old female newborn. The patient has been experiencing increasing yellow discoloration of her eyes and skin for 2 days. She was born at 39 weeks' gestation, initially weighed 3066 g and now weighs 3200 g. The patient is exclusively breastfed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Breast Milk Jaundice. Given the onset after 24 hours, peak at 2 weeks of age, and exclusive breastfeeding history, this clinical picture is consistent with breast milk jaundice rather than pathological early-onset jaundice.
